# kayjs-auth

> Auth for kay apps, built on kay's `session()`: OAuth sign-in with any provider, passwords, mailed links (email verification, password reset, magic links, email change), TOTP two-factor with recovery codes, bearer tokens for devices and API clients, security mails, a proof-of-work CAPTCHA or a third party's, a breached-password check, a fail-closed gate for routes, and prebuilt sign-in and account pages. It works in kay pages, actions and guards, and in a plain Elysia app. Its data lives in a store: in memory for tests, in Postgres or SQLite through pg-orm, or in any object keeping the store contract.

## Topics

The rest is split by topic, each file read whole with one command:

- [Setup, pages and the signed-in user](llms/setup.md): the setup, the prebuilt pages and the signed-in user
- [Sessions and guards](llms/sessions-and-guards.md): a user's sessions, guards and gates
- [OAuth sign-in, two-factor, passkeys, re-proof and the account](llms/oauth-passkeys-two-factor.md): OAuth providers, two-factor, passkeys, the recent proof sensitive changes ask for, and the account page
- [Passwords, guests, mailed links and security mails](llms/passwords-and-mails.md): passwords, guest sessions, mailed links (verification, reset, magic links) and security mails
- [The OAuth server for MCP clients, bearer tokens and forward auth](llms/oauth-server-and-tokens.md): signing an AI agent in through the OAuth server, bearer tokens, and guarding other sites for a reverse proxy
- [Events, the audit log, admin and organizations](llms/admin-and-organizations.md): auth events and the audit log, the admin pages, organizations and roles
- [The prebuilt admin pages](llms/admin-pages.md): the users, roles, bans, impersonation and audit log pages, and the banner while acting as a user
- [Bots, breached passwords, limits, stores, testing and the dev tool](llms/hardening-and-testing.md): proof of work and breached passwords, limits, the stores, testing an app using it, and the dev tool tab
- [The signed-in user in templates](llms/signed-in-components.md): SignedIn, SignedOut and UserMenu in a layout or component with no server fence, read in the first bytes of the pages using them
